3+ years of experience in business systems analysis, configuration, or support in a large, complex organization.

The Business Systems Analyst 3 (BSA 3) provides advanced business systems analysis and project support, primarily for the financial systems within UC Davis Health (UCDH) and in collaboration with the UC Davis Campus, including dedicated support to the Veterinary School of Medicine and AUSS-C. This position is responsible for understanding, configuring, and optimizing the ecotime® time and attendance system, as well as interfaced applications like Ansos, PeopleSoft (HR), and UCPath. The BSA 3 plays a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely processing of time and attendance data across multiple systems, aligning system functionality with financial, HR, and compliance requirements, including policy compliance, collective bargaining agreement (CBA) considerations, and accurate processing of pay based on the order and rules of integrated applications.
50% - Business Systems Analysis, Configuration, and Compliance (UCDH, Vet School, and AUSS-C)

This role includes vendor coordination, partnership with information technology teams, and providing expert guidance to UCDH, the Veterinary School of Medicine, and AUSS-C on process improvements, data integrity, and business process optimization. The BSA 3 will actively participate in cross-functional projects, systems analysis, configuration, testing, defect resolution, and support of financial and HR systems, with a focus on efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. This includes applying deep professional knowledge to independently perform the full range of responsibilities, including complex systems scope definition, process analysis, and business requirements gathering. The BSA 3 is expected to evaluate and resolve diverse, moderate to complex business process issues, demonstrating sound judgment in selecting methods and techniques to achieve optimal solutions.
20% - Project Support, Testing, and Process Improvement
Familiarity with institutional compliance requirements, audit readiness, and documentation standards, particularly in higher education or healthcare settings.
Familiarity with collective bargaining agreements, pay rules, and business rules as they relate to time and attendance systems.
Advanced business systems analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process mapping, data flow evaluation, and documentation to support complex financial and HR systems.

Advanced knowledge of time and attendance systems (preferably ecotime®) and integrated HR/finance applications such as UCPath, PeopleSoft, and Ansos, including configuration, testing, and troubleshooting.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities, demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and strong organizational skills in high-pressure environments.
Excellent communication skills, capable of translating technical details for diverse stakeholders and fostering collaboration between IT, HR, finance, and operational teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
Effective communication skills for diverse audiences and technical teams
Demonstrated testing and test planning skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
